info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Merchant Acquiring Facility API
info.description: The Merchant Acquiring Facility API provides access to vital information concerning merchant card acquisition services. This endpoint allows users to retrieve details about available merchant services and card processing capabilities. It's designed for developers and businesses involved in payment processing, offering insights into supported functionalities and options for merchant transactions. Typical consumers include payment service providers and e-commerce platforms looking to integrate acquiring services into their offerings.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of merchant acquiring facilities. It provides essential information that businesses need to understand their options for accepting card payments through merchant accounts.

requestBody.description: The request body for fetching details about the merchant acquiring facility. This should contain any necessary identifiers or filter options to retrieve specific data about the facility.

200.description: Successful retrieval of merchant acquiring facility information.
